origins.SUITE: Shared with the other Anne's Office apps (shell, files, AI providers, recovery)
origins.GPS: Family-history evidence practice (source, information and evidence analysis; written conclusions)
origins.AUD: Audit working-paper practice (tick marks, tie-out, footing, prepared/reviewed sign-off, roll-forward)
origins.FACT: Editorial fact-checking practice (checking copy line by line against sources)
origins.TXT: Textual scholarship (transcription, collation of versions, lines of descent between copies)
origins.LAW: Exhibit practice (numbered exhibits, sealed copies, redaction)
origins.OSINT: Open-source investigation practice (web capture, archiving, picture metadata, hash logs)
origins.SCI: Citation-context tools for scholarly literature (supporting, contrasting, retracted)
origins.ANNO: Web and document annotation tools (passages anchored by quotation)

tabs.name: Check
tabs.description: Tests the app computes itself, without AI: do the words, numbers, dates and files still agree?

commands.label: Run All Checks
commands.notes: every check below, results in the Problems pane

commands.label: Check on Save
commands.notes: toggle; default on

commands.label: Quote Check
commands.notes: a quotation must match its anchor letter for letter, allowing marked omissions and bracketed insertions; differences are shown word by word

commands.label: Paraphrase Reminder
commands.notes: lists claims tied to passages with no words in common, for a human look

commands.label: Name Check
commands.notes: the same person or organization spelled different ways across claims; variants in sources are kept, not corrected

commands.label: Citation Check
commands.notes: every citation has the fields its style needs; every cited work is a source in the case

commands.label: Number Check
commands.notes: a number claim equals its anchored figure under the stated rounding, unit and sign rules

commands.label: Sum Check

commands.label: Period Check

commands.label: Unit and Currency Check

commands.label: Number Consistency

commands.label: Precision Check
commands.notes: a claim more precise than its source (1,234,567 where the source says about 1.2 million)

commands.label: Materiality

commands.label: Date Check
commands.notes: impossible and unlikely sequences (died before born, child before parent, document dated before the event it reports)

commands.label: Calendar Check
commands.notes: Julian and Gregorian, dual-dated years, regnal and church calendars converted and compared on one scale

commands.label: Age Check
commands.notes: ages stated in sources against the dates claimed

commands.label: Independence Check

commands.label: Circular Citation Check

commands.label: Staleness Check

commands.label: Coverage

commands.label: Link Check
commands.notes: web sources still reachable; the saved capture is kept either way

commands.label: Weak Points

commands.label: Self-Contradiction
commands.notes: two claims about the same person or subject with conflicting dates or numbers

commands.label: Hedging Check

commands.label: Recency Check

commands.label: Retraction Check
